## How It Works
Three simple steps to your random result — no downloads, no sign‑up needed:

1. **Choose a Wheel** — Pick from 12+ ready‑made wheel types or start fresh with a blank wheel perfectly suited to your needs.
2. **Customize Options** — Edit labels, change colors, add or remove segments. Create the perfect wheel with unlimited custom options.
3. **Spin the Wheel** — Click the big SPIN button or press Space. Watch the wheel spin with a satisfying animation and reveal your result!
4. **See Your Result** — Celebrate the random result with confetti effects! Your spin history is saved so you can track all outcomes.

## Key Features
- **Fully Customizable** — Edit every segment — change text, colors, and quantity. Build any wheel you can imagine with unlimited options.
- **Confetti Celebration** — Every spin result is celebrated with a burst of colorful confetti, making the experience fun and rewarding.
- **Mobile Friendly** — Fully responsive design works perfectly on smartphones, tablets, and desktops. Spin on any device, anywhere.
- **Spin History** — Track your last 10 spin results with a live history log. See what the wheel has decided, all in one place.
- **Instant & Fast** — No loading times. The wheel loads instantly in your browser with smooth, physics‑based spin animations.
- **Privacy First** — Everything runs in your browser. No data is collected, no sign‑up needed, and your custom wheels stay private.
- **Accessible** — Keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, and screen reader support built in. The spin wheel is usable by everyone.
- **No Download Needed** — Pure browser‑based application. No app download, no installation — just open and spin in seconds.
- **Free Forever** — 100% free with no paywalls, no subscriptions. Every feature is available to every user at no cost.

## FAQ
- **Is it really free?** Yes — 100% free with no hidden charges, no premium tiers, and no subscription fees. All features are available to every user at no cost.
- **Do I need to create an account?** No account is required at all. Simply visit the site and start spinning immediately.
- **Where are my custom wheels stored?** All custom wheels are stored exclusively in your browser's local storage. Nothing is uploaded to external servers. Your data stays completely private.
- **Can I customize the wheel?** Absolutely. You can edit every segment's text and color, add or remove segments, and create unlimited custom wheels.
- **Does it work on mobile?** Yes! Fully responsive and optimized for smartphones, tablets, and desktops. Spin on any device, anywhere.
- **What happens if I clear my browser data?** Clearing browser data or local storage will delete your custom wheels and spin history. We recommend noting down important wheels if you need to keep them.
- **Does it work offline?** After the initial page load, the wheel runs entirely in your browser. No internet connection is required to spin.
- **Are there ads?** No, zero ads. Just a clean, distraction‑free spinning experience.
